# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas

## Deck Goal
向外部开发者介绍 Flow2Spec:一个让 AI 编码工具跨会话保持项目上下文的 Spec-driven 工作流层。用真实生产数据证明价值,并诚实说明边界。

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Flow2Spec 在项目里建立小而可路由的 .Knowledge/ 知识库(manifest 路由 + matchers 匹配词表 + topics 主题分片 + stock/req 文档),安装 f2s-* 技能,把任务状态(.task/)与产品知识分开。新会话按需求加载相关事实,而不是重新翻整个仓库。已在 4 个真实生产仓运行:主仓 A(前端主仓 3 年,1012 核心文件 12.9 万行,43 topic,27 位作者)、接口项目 B(Serverless,213 文件,25 topic)、B 端项目 C(73 文件,20 topic)、C 端项目 D(28 文件,15 topic)。",
    "core_claim": "不是让 AI 更聪明,是让 AI 一直知道你在做什么——上下文变准,而不是模型变强。",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "Memory Coding(记忆编码进可提交的仓库,可 diff 可协作)",
      ".Knowledge/(知识环)",
      ".task/(任务环)",
      "manifest → matcher → topic 路由链",
      "match → expand → verify → act 四步",
      "f2s-kb-feat / f2s-kb-fix / f2s-git-commit / f2s-kb-sync / f2s-kb-add / f2s-kb-distill",
      "topic / 终稿 / 代码 三层递进",
      "intentRecognition 意图识别"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "横向四阶段时间线:init → 首次接入 → 日常 → 维护,每阶段一张卡(顶部阶段标签胶囊分别青/品红/紫/琥珀,中间等宽字体命令示例,底部产出一行)。卡间青色箭头。首次接入卡里写两行命令:/f2s-doc-arch 和 /f2s-kb-add src/<模块>。底部一行金句。"
  }
}

## Style Reference Rule
Use Image 1 as the approved sample-slide style reference. Match its palette, typography mood, density, texture, and overall visual identity. Do not copy its exact layout unless this slide's layout explicitly asks for it.

## Input Image Handling Rules
For any input image marked as a strict input asset, include it visibly and preserve its content. Do not redraw, replace, relabel, or invent a similar figure. Scale and crop only as needed for composition while keeping the important labels, arrows, data, and relationships recognizable.

## Universal Constraints
- The final image itself must contain the title and key points.
- Render Chinese text exactly and legibly; avoid garbled characters.
- Keep the confirmed deck style consistent while varying layout by slide role.
- No watermark or unrelated logo. Render the page number exactly as specified in Constraints (bottom-right, e.g. 03 / 16), matching the approved sample's footer.

## 本次重生成修正(最高优先级)
- 第 1 张 init 卡的命令框只能写一行命令:flow2spec init(等宽字体),注释「# 初始化基础结构」——禁止在 init 卡出现 /f2s-kb-add 或 manifest.yml 等任何其他命令或路径;注意「初始化」三字写正确。
- 第 2 张首次接入卡命令保持:/f2s-doc-arch 与 /f2s-kb-add src/<模块>。
- 其余保持上一版优点:四阶段胶囊配色、顶部要点区、底部金句、页码 12 / 16。
